'''Sunry vs. the Ahto City Authority''' was a trial held in [[3956 BBY]] by the [[Ahto City Civil Authority]], where [[Sunry]] was tried for the murder of [[Elassa Huros]]. [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] defended Sunry. Witnesses were [[Ignus]], [[Firith Me]], [[Gluupor]], [[Elora]], and Sunry. The presiding judges were [[Shelkar]], [[Jhosa]], [[Naleshekan]], [[Kota]], and [[Duula]]. The end result was the acquittal of Sunry on all charges. Elassa's killer was never identified.<ref name="The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
